internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: The CAB shall formally meet at least three times annually, primarily at Cinemark's Service Center, located in Plano, TX. Meetings shall take place over one business day, typically from 8:30am until 4:30pm. Efforts will be made to accommodate school and work schedules. Meetings may be held at other locations or virtually. Attendance at CAB meetings is mandatory and shall be a requirement for membership.
